title: Implement deterministic Artifact Hash Generator
description: Implement frozen multi-agent Item 5: exact-byte content hashing, deterministic canonical artifact manifests, and artifact approval binding for ADD/MODIFY/DELETE/RENAME operations.

why_medium: Artifact hashes become a governance primitive used to bind future review and Human Approval to exact content.
A defect could make future approvals stale or incorrectly reusable even though this task itself changes only isolated multi-agent governance code.
The implementation is deterministic, additive, reversible, and does not mutate protected commerce, authentication, financial, database migration, production, or GitHub protection state.
why_not_high: No current sensitive business-domain path or security policy is changed.
No Human Gate decision is executed by this task; it only generates deterministic binding evidence for later enforcement.
The three changed files are outside current Project Map HIGH sensitive zones.

lock.rule: No conflicting writer may mutate these paths until this Item 5 PR is merged or aborted.

artifact_binding_contract.rename_extension: from_path is included in canonical manifest to bind original path identity.
artifact_binding_contract.delete_bytes: DELETE must supply the exact pre-change/deleted Git blob bytes.
artifact_binding_contract.commit_sha: Traceability metadata only and excluded from artifact_hash.

canonical_manifest_serialization.note: Spec v3.1 requires canonical_manifest_bytes but does not prescribe byte serialization. Item 5 defines this deterministic serialization contract explicitly.
rules: Normalize repository-relative paths with the canonical Scope/Lock path normalizer.
Hash exact supplied Uint8Array/Buffer bytes without text or line-ending normalization.
Build fixed-key manifest entries and include from_path only for RENAME.
Sort by normalized destination path, then operation, then from_path, then content_sha256.
Serialize the manifest with JSON.stringify and UTF-8 encoding with no whitespace.

acceptance_criteria.description: Only ADD/MODIFY/DELETE/RENAME operations are accepted and malformed operations fail closed.
content_sha256 is SHA256 of exact supplied bytes; line-ending or single-byte changes produce different bindings.
artifact_hash is SHA256 of deterministic compact UTF-8 canonical manifest bytes and is independent of input order.
DELETE binds exact pre-change bytes and RENAME binds from_path, destination path and current content bytes.
Any operation, content, normalized path or RENAME source-path change invalidates the artifact hash.
commit_sha is traceability metadata only and does not participate in artifact_hash.
Unsafe repository paths, duplicate normalized destinations and duplicate rename sources fail closed.
Artifact binding evidence is recursively immutable and deterministic.
Existing multi-agent wildcard integration runs Item 5 without package.json changes and canonical verification remains green.
PR diff contains only the three declared write-scope files and no forbidden path.
